name: omni-media-ledger
description: No build step for the app itself -- this package.json exists only to run the checks. `npm run test-fast` (~15s) is everything except the browser suite; `npm run test-browser` (~7 min) is the Playwright suite in test/regression.js, which CI runs on every pull request.

scripts.test: npm run test-fast && npm run test-browser
scripts.test-fast: node scripts/validate-corpus.js && node test/schema.js && node test/fetch-facts.js && node test/fetch-substance.js && node test/score-batch.js
